# Disagreement Log — GTH_079

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 79
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 79 | "nourished you" | "nursed you" | "fed you" | Breastfeeding verb: *soou* range |
| 2 | 79 | "have truly kept it" | "have kept it in truth" | "truly kept it" | Adverb placement: modifying verb vs. manner |
| 3 | 79 | "Blessed are those" (no contrast) | "Blessed are those" | "Blessed rather are those" | PNEUMA adds "rather" — not in Coptic |
| 4 | 79 | "have not given milk" | "have not nursed" | "never nursed" | Negative: *have not* vs. *never* |

**Total disagreements: 4**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "nourished," "truly kept it," no added "rather," and "have not given milk" (descriptive, slightly different emphasis from "nursed").
